name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohung Kaissenhof
beschreibung: The Kaissenhof in Ebbs is a farm that offers holiday apartments. The accommodations are equipped with a kitchen-cum-living room, bedroom, and bathroom. Guests have access to a garden with seating. The farm is located in the Tiroler Unterland in a quiet position on the edge of the village. From here, the towns of Kufstein and Kiefersfelden can be reached quickly. Hiking trails and cross-country ski trails start in the nearby area. The accommodation offering is aimed at couples and families.
